1	# CLAUDE.md — EV Dashboard project
2	
3	**For any Claude session starting fresh on this codebase.** Read this first. Then SESSION_SUMMARY.md for current stage. Everything else links from there.
4	
5	## What this is
6	
7	A personal-use Mac app for Ian McAdam (Ontario, first-time EV buyer) to compare every EV / PHEV / EREV for sale in Canada. New and used. Not a shipped product — no signing, no distribution, no auto-update. Ian runs it on his MacBook Pro; he and his mom use it to research his next vehicle.
8	
9	## Non-negotiable principles
10	
11	1. **Scientific rigor.** Every number displayed is cited and tagged with confidence (High / Medium / Low). Never fabricate precision — mark Low and move on.
12	2. **Traceability.** Every claim has a `source` field pointing to the URL it came from, with the date accessed. Stored inline in seed.json.
13	3. **Personal use only.** If a proposal smells like "for shipping," kill it. No code signing, notarization, or distribution infra.
14	4. **Scope discipline.** Long-range trims only: longest-range single-motor variant + longest-range AWD variant. Skip base trims, skip performance trims. Distinct entries per generation.
15

1	# EV Dashboard — Project Plan (v2)
2	
3	**A standalone Mac desktop app to compare every EV, PHEV, and EREV for sale in Canada (new + used), with a showroom-style browse, dense spec-compare view, a physics-accurate temperature/preconditioning slider, and an Apple-MapKit map with range rings, live charger pins, and (later) trip planning.**
4	
5	Built for: Ian McAdam, Ontario — first-time EV buyer replacing an ICE vehicle.
6	Last updated: 2026-04-23.
7	
8	---
9	
10	## 1. Guiding principle — scientific rigor is non-negotiable
11	
12	Ian will make a real purchase decision with this tool. Every number displayed must be traceable to an independently-verified source, and the temperature/preconditioning slider must be physics-informed — not a cosmetic curve.
13	
14	**What this means operationally:**
15	
16	- Every spec field in the dataset (range, usable kWh, peak DC kW, port type, tow rating) must be cross-checked against at least two independent sources before it lands in the database. Manufacturer marketing is a third opinion, not a source of truth.
17	- Range figures are labeled by test protocol: **EPA** (North American, what Canadian buyers actually experience), **WLTP** (European, optimistic for us), **Real-world** (community-observed). Never silently convert between them.
18	- Every vehicle gets a confidence flag (High / Medium / Low) for its winter model. If we don't have data to calibrate it, we say so rather than fabricate precision.
19	- Web-sourced facts get cited in a code comment next to the data, so we can re-validate when the source updates.
20	- When hunting data we are ruthless: cross-reference OEM spec sheets, NRCan FuelEconomy.ca, EPA fueleconomy.gov, EV-Database.org, Recurrent Auto fleet reports, Geotab Winter EV Range dataset, ABRP vehicle parameters, P3 Group charging tests, Bjørn Nyland 1000 km challenges, Out of Spec Reviews, InsideEVs independent tests, Fastned stats.
21	
22	## 2. Feature set (locked in)
23	
24	**Main page:** Standard filter bar across the top (price, powertrain type, body style, charging port, drivetrain, year). Below, a vertically-scrolling list grouped by brand — each brand shows its models underneath like a buyer's directory.
25	
26	**Trim scope:** For every model, include only the *longest-range single-motor variant* (RWD or FWD, whichever the model offers) and the *longest-range AWD variant*. Skip base/standard-range trims. Skip performance/tri-motor/quad-motor trims. Some models will have one entry (e.g., F-150 Lightning — AWD only), some two (e.g., Model 3 LR RWD + LR AWD).
27	
28	**Generations are distinct entries.** IONIQ 5 pre-2025 vs IONIQ 5 2025+, Model 3 Highland vs pre-Highland, Rivian R1 Gen1 vs Gen2, Mach-E 2021 vs 2024 refresh, etc. Battery chemistry, thermal management, and charging curves change across generations — collapsing them would break accuracy.
29	
30	**Compare tray:** Pull up to 4 vehicles into a dense side-by-side spec view. Charging curves overlaid on a single kW-vs-SoC graph. All numbers live-update with the slider.
31	
32	**Temperature + preconditioning slider:** -40 °C to +40 °C slider, with a preconditioning on/off toggle per compared vehicle. Drives live recalculation of range, Le/100 km, DCFC stop time, charging-curve peak, usable kWh. Details in §4.
33	
34	**Map panel (Apple MapKit JS):** Your location pinned. Concentric range rings per compared vehicle, color-matched to the compare tray. DCFC station pins from Open Charge Map inside the rings, color-coded by max kW. Station occupancy / "busy" status overlaid where we can get it (Tesla Supercharger API for Tesla, PlugShare-style community data elsewhere — coverage is partial and we'll label it).
35	
36	**Canadian pricing & incentives:** MSRP from manufacturer, federal iZEV (verify current 2026 status on every refresh), provincial incentives where applicable. Disclaimer and source link on every incentive figure.
37	
38	**Cost-per-100km in real Ontario dollars:** Tied to your home electricity rate, recalculating with the slider.
39	
40	**Used market (Phase 4):** AutoTrader.ca + Kijiji nationwide. Listing count, median asking price, cheapest 5 / nearest 5 with links back to source.
41	
42	**Trip planning (Phase 5):** Pick destination, render route line on MapKit, per-vehicle charge-stops with estimated stop times and live station occupancy. Route engine chosen at Phase 5 time — ABRP API is the leading candidate (EV-routing industry standard); self-built fallback (Mapbox Directions + Open Charge Map + our charging-curve math) is on the table if we want zero dependencies.
43	
44	**Explicitly out of scope:** Turn-by-turn live nav while driving. Winter-tire range toggle (dropped per Ian — keeps accuracy focus sharp).
45	
46	## 3. Tech stack
47	
48	| Layer | Choice | Why |
49	|---|---|---|
50	| Desktop shell | **Tauri 2** | Native Apple Silicon performance, ~10 MB bundle, system WebKit — far better than Electron on your Mac. |
51	| UI | **React + TypeScript + Vite** | Mainstream, great AI-assisted-coding support, fast HMR. |
52	| Styling | **Tailwind + shadcn/ui** | Clean showroom aesthetics, consistent dense tables. |
53	| State | **Zustand** | Minimal boilerplate, enough power for filter/compare/slider state. |
54	| Tables | **TanStack Table** | Best-in-class for dense side-by-side compare. |
55	| Charts | **Recharts** (or **visx**) | Charging-curve overlays, slider-driven graphs. |
56	| Map | **Apple MapKit JS** | Native Mac look, free, no API-key pain for personal use, beautiful defaults. |
57	| Scrapers | **Python + Playwright + BeautifulSoup** | Best scraping ecosystem; handles JS-heavy OEM sites. Runs as Tauri sidecar. |
58	| Local DB | **SQLite** (`better-sqlite3` in app, `sqlite3` in Python) | File-based, zero-config, perfect for this dataset size. |
59	| Packaging | **Tauri bundler** → signed `.dmg` | Proper installable Mac app. |
60	
61	## 4. The physics-accurate slider — how we actually build it
62	
63	Per vehicle+generation, we store a small parameter set:
64	
65	```
66	thermal_profile
67	  base_efficiency_whkm       # kWh/100km at 20°C, steady-state highway
68	  battery_chemistry          # LFP | NMC | NCA | LMR
69	  thermal_management         # active_liquid | passive | active_refrigerant
70	  has_heat_pump              # bool
71	  heat_pump_min_effective_c  # below this, HP switches to resistive (e.g. Tesla -10°C)
72	  cold_derate_curve          # array of {temp_c, pct_range_retained} observed points
73	  precon_time_by_temp        # minutes to precondition battery for DCFC at [0, -10, -20, -30]
74	  precon_thermal_gain        # % DCFC peak recovered when preconditioned vs cold-soaked
75	  charging_curve             # array of {soc_pct, kw_20c, kw_cold} observed points
76	  hvac_draw_kw_by_temp       # HVAC power pull at ambient temperatures
77	  sources                    # array of URLs/citations backing each of the above
78	  confidence                 # High | Medium | Low
79	```
80	
81	**Range at a given slider state = f(rated_range, ambient_temp, preconditioned, hvac_on, chemistry_penalty, heat_pump_bonus).**
82	
83	The function is the sum of well-understood physical effects — battery capacity derate with temperature (published per chemistry, validated against Geotab), HVAC draw (Recurrent Auto's data is excellent here), regen loss when cold, plus a per-vehicle calibration constant fit to observed winter tests. Not hand-wavy.
84	
85	**When calibration data is thin:** we fall back to a chemistry-+-thermal-system baseline curve, flag the vehicle as Medium or Low confidence, and surface that in the UI so you can see where the number is guessed vs measured.
86	
87	**Charging curve under temperature:** we store the 20 °C curve as published/tested, plus a cold-soaked curve from community tests. Preconditioning toggle blends between them. When only the warm curve exists, confidence drops and we say so.
88	
89	## 5. Phased build roadmap
90	
91	| Phase | Goal | Headline deliverable |
92	|---|---|---|
93	| **1** | MVP installable Mac app | Tauri + React + Tailwind scaffold, SQLite, curated seed of ~20 top Canadian EV/PHEV/EREV vehicles (Long Range trims only, with generation splits), brand-grouped list, compare tray, static spec view, first signed-or-unsigned `.dmg`. |
94	| **2** | Automated ingestion for all models | Python scraper framework — one module per OEM Canadian site, plus EV-Database.org. Generation-aware normalization. Refresh button wired up. Confidence flags seeded. |
95	| **3** | The physics slider + map | Per-vehicle thermal profiles. Slider-driven live recalculation across the compare tray. Apple MapKit panel with range rings + OCM DCFC pins + occupancy where available. Charging-curve overlay chart. Cost-per-100km tied to ON electricity rate. |
96	| **4** | Used market | AutoTrader.ca + Kijiji nationwide scrapers with rotating headers + throttling + graceful degradation. Per-model listing panels. |
97	| **5** | Trip planning | Destination picker, route rendering on MapKit, per-vehicle charge-stop plan with live station-occupancy flags. Engine decision (ABRP vs self-built) made at phase start. |
98	| **6** | Polish & package | Signed/notarized `.dmg`, auto-update scaffolding (optional), install guide, troubleshooting. |
99	
100	Each phase ends with a usable app. You can stop at any phase and still have a tool worth opening.
101	
102	## 6. Data model (updated)
103	
104	```
105	brands            (id, name, country, logo_url)
106	
107	vehicles          (id, brand_id, model, generation_label, year_start, year_end,
108	                   powertrain BEV|PHEV|EREV, body_style,
109	                   drivetrain_variant SINGLE_MOTOR|AWD)
110	  -- one row per generation × drivetrain; base/performance trims excluded
111	
112	specs             (vehicle_id, battery_kwh_total, battery_kwh_usable, battery_chemistry,
113	                   range_km_epa, range_km_wltp, ac_charge_kw_max, dc_charge_kw_max,
114	                   port_type, seats, cargo_l_up, cargo_l_down, tow_rating_kg,
115	                   weight_kg, drive_wheels, seats)
116	
117	thermal_profile   (vehicle_id, base_efficiency_whkm, thermal_management,
118	                   has_heat_pump, heat_pump_min_effective_c,
119	                   precon_thermal_gain_pct, confidence)
120	
121	thermal_points    (vehicle_id, metric, temp_c, value, source_url, source_name)
122	  -- stores the cold_derate_curve, precon_time_by_temp, hvac_draw_kw_by_temp
123	  -- as flat (temp, value) rows with citations
124	
125	charging_curves   (vehicle_id, preconditioned bool, soc_pct, kw, source_url)
126	
127	pricing           (vehicle_id, msrp_cad, federal_izev_cad, provincial_rebate_cad,
128	                   effective_price_cad, as_of_date, source_url)
129	
130	used_listings     (id, vehicle_id, year, km, price_cad, province,
131	                   source AutoTrader|Kijiji, url, seen_at)
132	
133	sources           (id, url, name, accessed_at, notes)
134	  -- central citation table; everything else FKs to this
135	```
136	
137	## 7. Risks and how we handle them
138	
139	- **Federal iZEV rebate** was paused in early 2025 and its 2026 status is unclear. App always shows "verify on transport.canada.ca" with a live link; cache the verified state per refresh.
140	- **Ontario has no active provincial rebate** as of 2026 — app reflects this honestly.
141	- **AutoTrader.ca / Kijiji hostile to scrapers.** Modular per-source design; one broken scraper does not crash the run. Personal-use only.
142	- **Real-time charger occupancy is patchy** across networks. We label each station pin with the source of its status and an age-of-last-update. No fake green dots.
143	- **Thin winter data for new models.** Confidence flags in the UI; explicit "calibrated against N data points" hover tooltip.
144	- **Apple notarization cost.** Unsigned `.app` runs locally fine (right-click → Open once). Proper signed build requires the $99/yr Apple Developer account — optional, your call when we get to Phase 6.
145	
146	## 8. What I need from you before I start Phase 1
147	
148	1. Any models you already know you want in the seed set of 20? (Otherwise I'll pick the most cross-shopped Canadian-market EV/PHEV/EREV vehicles for 2026 across mainstream + premium.)
149	2. What Ontario city (or postal code) should I use as your default "home" location for the map and for the default Ontario electricity rate?

151	
152	Give me those three answers and I'll scaffold Phase 1 end-to-end.
